s.g: An exclamation used to startle or frighten.
A community of bohemians, unconventional artists or writers.
The world or social milieu of such bohemians.
A person, especially an artist or writer, who lives an unconventional or nonconformist lifestyle.
Unconventional, especially in habit or dress.
A native or resident of Bohemia.
Of, or relating to Bohemia or its language.
(rhetoric) A word or phrase characteristic of the Bohemian language.
Of the physicist David Bohm and his Bohm interpretation of quantum mechanics.
A style of female fashion drawing on various bohemian and hippie influences, popular in the mid-2000s.
(physical chemistry, quantum mechanics) Synonym of Bohr radius.
(Islam) A member of a particular Sevener Shi'ite denomination, now found mainly in India.
